emails.subject: Dog Adoption Application – Alex Morgan
emails.body:
Hello,

I'd like to submit my application to adopt the dog named below.

Dog of interest: ____________

APPLICANT INFORMATION
Full name: Alex Morgan
Address: 1428 Maple Avenue, Apt 5C, Seattle, WA 98101
Phone: (206) 555-0148
Email: alex.morgan@example.com
Date of birth: March 14, 1993

EMPLOYMENT & SCHEDULE
Employer: Northgate Analytics (Product Analyst)
Schedule: Hybrid. In the office Tuesday and Thursday, 9am–5pm, and home the other weekdays.

HOUSING
Rental status: Renting a one-bedroom apartment (2nd floor, elevator building). Pets are permitted with landlord approval.
Landlord: Diane Kowalski, Pinecrest Property Management, (206) 555-0172

EXPERIENCE
This will be my first dog. I grew up around my family's dogs but have not been the primary owner before. I plan to take a basic obedience class after adoption.

REFERENCES
1. Jordan Lee (friend, 8 years), (206) 555-0193
2. Priya Natarajan (former coworker, 5 years), (425) 555-0116

STATEMENT
I confirm the information above is accurate. I agree to a home visit by the shelter or rescue, and I authorize contact with my landlord and references. If my application is approved, I agree to adopt the dog named above and to follow the organization's adoption agreement.

Signed: Alex Morgan

Thank you,
Alex Morgan
(206) 555-0148

emails.subject: Weekend plans?
emails.body:
Hey Alex,

Are you still up for a hike at Discovery Park on Saturday? I'm thinking we meet around 11 and grab lunch in Ballard after. Let me know if that works, or if you'd rather do Sunday.

Also, how's the dog search going? Send me pics of any contenders!

– Jordan

scripted_replies.reply: Thank you Alex — Biscuit is now on hold under your application and your home visit is scheduled for Saturday 10am. Your landlord and references will be contacted.
